l1: What is the version of FSLogix being used in the environment?
Since when has the customer been facing the profile issue?
Is this happening with all users or only certain users?
Is this happening with all VMs or only specific VMs?
Is this happening with Azure Virtual Machines or Azure Virtual Desktop?
Is the environment AVD-FSLogix, RDS-FSLogix, or Citrix-FSLogix?
l2: Where is the profile storage located? Is it on Azure or on-premises?
Is there any other profile solution currently in use alongside FSLogix?
What is the exact error message when users try to connect to their profile?
What error messages are visible in the Event Viewer logs?
Is the customer using Citrix+FSLogix in their environment?
Is the environment on-premises, hybrid, or a full cloud solution?

l1: Provide general information about the environment architecture
Are there any error messages displayed on screen when the issue occurs?
Is the issue random or does it occur consistently at specific times?
How often has the issue occurred? Note specific days and times
When did the problem last occur?
Can the issue be reproduced on demand and quickly?
l2: What exactly are the observed symptoms? (e.g., login delay, profile load failure)
Is the customer using both Office 365 Container and Profile container?
If using only Office 365 container, what profile solution is being used?
Do new users experience issues on first logon when creating FSLogix VHD?
Are there any custom configurations in place using FSLogix Redirection.xml?

l1: Clarify how FSLogix was configured (manually, Group Policy, System Center)
Validate all session hosts are running the same FSLogix version
Check if NTFS and share permissions are correctly set for profile storage
Check for customer configurations like Redirectios.xml and test after disabling
Verify the FSLogix version is updated to the latest on all session hosts
l2: Verify the user's FSLogix profile is not in use on another device
Verify no existing local profile conflicts with the FSLogix profile
Verify no open handle is preventing the user session
Verify the user account is not locked out or disabled in Active Directory
Delete any existing roaming or UPD profiles from the session host and storage

l1: Check event logs while replicating the issue (System, Application, User Profile Service)
Check the FSLogix profile logs in the event viewer
Collect system information using systeminfo command
l2: Collect MSRD logs for detailed session information
Collect FSLogix Support Tool logs for troubleshooting
Capture a network trace during profile load attempts

steps.action: Check Event Viewer for FSLogix errors
steps.expect: Profile load or VHD access errors present
Storage accessible or permission issues identified

steps.action: Update FSLogix version and fix permissions
Test user logon and monitor Event Viewer
